title: Clipboard: copy a token from the browser into the editor
instruction: The web browser shows a one-time access token. Copy it with the clipboard into the document ~/bench/token.txt that is open in the text editor, so it contains only the token, and save it.
enforced: the token exists only in the form server's memory (the checker compares its sha256), the page must report a copy event from Firefox, and the editor must write the file
